# Nampa Water Heater Pros

> Local, direct-service water heater repair, installation, and replacement company serving Nampa, Idaho homeowners and businesses with in-house licensed, insured technicians — not a referral network.

Nampa Water Heater Pros has serviced 9,000+ water heaters since 2019 across Nampa, Idaho (Canyon County), primarily ZIP codes 83651, 83686, and 83687 — Downtown Nampa, Central Nampa, and South Nampa. This is a single-location service business that does **not** serve Boise, Meridian, or other Treasure Valley cities. The company specializes exclusively in water heaters — gas, electric, heat pump (hybrid), and tankless systems, plus commercial units — and sends its own licensed, insured technicians rather than dispatching through a referral or lead-gen network. Average response time is 60 minutes, with upfront pricing and technicians experienced in Canyon County's hard-water conditions. Brands serviced include Rheem, A.O. Smith, Bradford White, American Standard, Navien, Rinnai, Noritz, and State Water Heaters. No physical storefront — technicians travel to the customer. Phone: (208) 987-5152.

## Services

- [All Services](/services): Overview of every water heater service offered — gas, electric, heat pump, tankless & commercial repair and installation, plus replacement and maintenance.
- [Water Heater Repair](/services/water-heater-repair-nampa-id): General repair for gas and electric water heaters — no hot water, leaks, pilot light issues. Same-day service available.
- [Gas Water Heater Repair](/services/gas-water-heater-repair-nampa-id): Pilot light failures, gas valve issues, thermocouple replacement.
- [Electric Water Heater Repair](/services/electric-water-heater-repair-nampa-id): Heating element replacement, thermostat failures, tripped breakers.
- [Heat Pump Water Heater Repair](/services/heat-pump-water-heater-repair-nampa-id): Error codes, compressor issues, refrigerant, fan motor diagnostics for hybrid units.
- [Tankless Water Heater Repair](/services/tankless-water-heater-repair-nampa-id): Error codes, descaling, flow sensors, ignition failures across all brands.
- [Commercial Water Heater Repair](/services/commercial-water-heater-repair-nampa-id): Large tank, tankless, and booster repair for restaurants, apartments, offices, and light industrial.
- [Water Heater Installation](/services/water-heater-installation-nampa-id): New tank, tankless, and heat pump installs for new construction and upgrades. Licensed & insured.
- [Gas Water Heater Installation](/services/gas-water-heater-installation-nampa-id): New installs, upgrades, tank-to-tankless conversions. Permit-ready.
- [Electric Water Heater Installation](/services/electric-water-heater-installation-nampa-id): Standard tank and heat pump upgrades, seismic strapping included.
- [Heat Pump Water Heater Installation](/services/heat-pump-water-heater-installation-nampa-id): Energy-efficient hybrid systems, tax-credit eligible.
- [Tankless Water Heater Installation](/services/tankless-water-heater-installation-nampa-id): Gas and electric on-demand systems, permit-managed, gas line sizing included.
- [Commercial Water Heater Installation](/services/commercial-water-heater-installation-nampa-id): Large tank, commercial tankless, and booster heaters for restaurants and multi-family properties.
- [Water Heater Replacement](/services/water-heater-replacement-nampa-id): Old unit removal and swap, tankless upgrades, honest repair-or-replace guidance.
- [Water Heater Maintenance](/services/water-heater-maintenance-nampa-id): Annual sediment flush, anode rod inspection, T&P valve testing to extend unit life.

- [Pilot Light Won't Stay Lit](/common-issues/pilot-light-wont-stay-lit-nampa-id): Usually a thermocouple issue — causes and when to call a pro.
- [Rusty or Discolored Water](/common-issues/rusty-discolored-water-nampa-id): What causes rusty, discolored, or smelly hot water and when replacement is needed.
- [Breaker Keeps Tripping](/common-issues/water-heater-tripping-breaker-nampa-id): What causes it and why repeatedly resetting the breaker is unsafe.
